title: Prowler Sound
blurb: The Prowler sound — that snarling electronic drone from Spider-Verse that TikTok turned into the official audio of menacing arrivals. When someone shows up with bad intentions and good posture, this plays. Use it for villain entrances, gym walk-ins, and cats appearing at 3am. One of the most-used edit sounds of the Spider-Verse era, still terrifying.
origin: Uncle Aaron's Prowler theme from Into the Spider-Verse, TikTok's menace sound.
